air:Brand.Name: ECONOMY BASIC
air:Brand.air:Title: Economy Basic
YBASIC
air:Brand.air:Text: A smart choice for travellers who don’t require checked baggage.

Etihad’s Economy cabins are designed for comfort, convenience and calm. Settle into ergonomic seats with generous recline and cosy blankets, switch on with hours of on-demand entertainment, and indulge in delicious complimentary food and drinks. On longer flights, surf or stream with onboard Wi-Fi or stay up to date with live TV and news.
• Cabin baggage: 7kg • No checked baggage • Change not permitted • Refund not permitted • Earn 15% Etihad Guest Miles
* Refer to fare rules for full terms and conditions * Products and services may vary between aircraft and on flights operated by other airlines

air:Brand.Name: ECONOMY LIGHT
air:Brand.air:Title: Economy Light
ECOLITE
air:Brand.air:Text:
ECONOMY LIGHT - the most affordable choice for customer who require less flexibility and services but who still wish to enjoy the full Gulf Air experience • Highest charges for changes, cancellations or refunds • 2 checked bags included • Additional fees for advance seat selection
Choose our SMART fare for more flexibility and free standard seat selection.
* Cabin interior and features may not be exactly as shown
* Please refer to detailed fare rules for more information * Please note that if the flight is operated by another airline then the onboard product or service may be different to that described above

air:Brand.Name: ECONOMY CLASSIC
air:Brand.air:Title: Economy Classic
ECLASSIC
air:Brand.air:Text: Benefit from more checked baggage allowance and more Q miles

Economy Classic includes - 25kg checked baggage - Carry on 7kg (1 piece) - 50% Qmiles accumulation - Refund to original form of payment (chargeable) - Upgrade with Qmiles - Change allowed with charge
• Please note that if the flight is operated by another airline then the on-board product or service maybe different to that described above. Fare quote for more accurate inclusions and fare conditions.

air:Brand.Name: ECONOMY SAVER
air:Brand.air:Title: Economy Saver
ECSAVER
air:Brand.air:Text: Economy Saver: Fly at a low fare and save more for your trip. Enjoy the services included with your ticket and pay a small fee for more comfort. • Checked baggage allowance (exception may apply) • Carryon luggage – 7KG’s • Assign your own seat with an additional fee • Changeable ticket available with an additional fee • Non-refund before departure • Non-refundable after departure • Earn more miles
